ARCHIVE CONSOLE D
ACCELERATOR INTERLOCK<New>Bank test accepted.
Accelerator supply restored.
Magnetic banks responding.<New>CENTRAL GATE
Accelerator power requirement
satisfied.<Close>

ACCELERATOR SERVICE RECORD
ARCHIVED SHIFT LOG / 6081
OPERATOR: ARON<New>Cooling pumps checked after
the power failure. Bank Two
stopped at the thermal limit
during the recharge test. No
damage found.<New>Command has requested
continuous readiness. That
requires bypassing the
thermal cutoff.<New>Cooling time between charges
is still necessary.<New>SHIFT ADDENDUM
Bypass fitted by Aron.
Temperature must be watched
from the control desk while
the bank is charging.<New>ARON / TO: LENA
I told them it was ready.
Perhaps that will be enough.
I don't want to find out how
long we can keep doing this.<New>TERMINAL DIRECTORY
ACCELERATOR INTERLOCK
CONTROL: MAIN CONSOLE<Close>
